description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, it and Composer of Spring trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Composer of Spring trigger, putting Rakdos Carnarium onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
